listings.name: NewPsych Psychologists
listings.credentials: Clinical Psychologists, Psychiatrists, Couples & Family Therapists
listings.google_search: NewPsych Psychologists Newcastle reviews
listings.description: One of Newcastle's largest and most established psychology practices — psychologists, clinical psychologists, psychiatrists, and couples therapists working together. Over 25 years of service, with a comprehensive EAP offering for corporate clients.
listings.long_description:
NewPsych Psychologists has been serving the Newcastle community for over 25 years. Located in the heart of Newcastle CBD, the practice brings together a diverse team of psychologists, clinical psychologists, psychiatrists, and couples and family therapists.

The team at NewPsych understands that everyone experiences tough times and that talking things through with a trusted professional can help you think differently and take action. They help clients develop unique solutions to their particular situations.

NewPsych also offers a comprehensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for corporate clients, including education and training, manager assist, fitness for work assessments, and support for organisations wanting to improve their psychological safety.

listings.name: Elevated Wellbeing Psychology
listings.credentials: Registered Psychologists, Mental Health Social Workers
listings.google_search: Elevated Wellbeing Psychology Wickham Newcastle reviews
listings.description: A warm, welcoming team of Newcastle psychologists and mental health social workers providing evidence-based therapy including EMDR, CBT, ACT, and TF-CBT. Currently accepting new clients.
listings.long_description:
Elevated Wellbeing Psychology is a team of Newcastle psychologists and mental health social workers who provide a warm, comfortable space for therapy and support.

Their friendly mental health professionals use a variety of evidence-based, practical, effective, and personalised psychological strategies to provide counselling for people in the Newcastle and Lake Macquarie region.

Therapy approaches include EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing), ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy), TF-CBT (Trauma Focused Cognitive Behavioural Therapy), CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy), Motivational Interviewing, and Mindfulness Strategies.

listings.name: New Lambton Psychology
listings.google_search: New Lambton Psychology reviews
listings.description: A highly regarded clinical psychology practice with over 10 years of experience. Specialises in individual therapy, group programs, psychological assessments for children, and clinical supervision.
listings.long_description:
New Lambton Psychology is a clinical psychology practice providing compassionate, ethical, evidence-based psychology services for a broad range of issues. Treatment approaches are individually tailored to help clients develop the tools and resources they need to create positive and lasting change.

Services include individual therapy for children, adolescents and adults, group programs, psychological and diagnostic assessments for children up to age 16, and clinical supervision for psychologists and other health professionals.

All clinicians are endorsed as Clinical Psychologists by AHPRA and complete yearly professional training. The practice is located in a beautifully designed 'home' space at 37 Freyberg Street, specifically created to ensure clients feel safe and comfortable.

listings.name: Lacuna Clinical Psychology
listings.google_search: Lacuna Clinical Psychology Mayfield Newcastle reviews
listings.description: Mayfield-based practice specialising in emotion-focused and trauma-informed therapy. Session fee $250, with ~$104.75 out-of-pocket after Medicare rebate.
listings.long_description:
Lacuna Clinical Psychology is a Mayfield-based practice specialising in emotion-focused and trauma-informed therapy. The team works with clients whose difficulties are driven by emotions, emotional avoidance, or emotional vulnerability.

Session fee is $250. If you have a Mental Health Care Plan your out-of-pocket cost will be approximately $104.75 after the Medicare rebate. Health funds and DVA are also accepted.

A GP referral is not required to book, however a Mental Health Care Plan referral from your GP will provide Medicare rebates for up to 10 sessions per calendar year. Free untimed street parking is available nearby.

listings.address: Level 1, Suite 6, 19 Bolton Street, Newcastle NSW 2300
listings.google_search: Oracle Psychology Newcastle reviews
listings.description: Newcastle's dedicated child and adolescent psychology practice, led by Principal Clinical Psychologist Daniel Wendt. Unique combination of Education and Psychology expertise.
listings.long_description:
Oracle Psychology is Newcastle's dedicated child and adolescent psychology practice, led by Principal Clinical Psychologist and Director Daniel Wendt. Daniel's qualifications in both Education and Psychology offer a unique combination of expertise well-suited to assisting children and young people.

The practice works with children, adolescents, and their families across a broad range of presentations including ADHD assessment and management, Autism Spectrum Disorder, learning difficulties, anxiety, and behavioural issues. Oracle also assists adults and practises across the lifespan.

The team accepts NDIS funding and Mental Health Care Plans, and offers telehealth services.

listings.name: Psychology Centre Newcastle

listings.description: A team of clinical and forensic psychologists delivering specialised care across all ages using ACT, CBT, EMDR and Schema Therapy.
listings.long_description:
Psychology Centre Newcastle brings together a team of clinical and forensic psychologists combining rigorous clinical training and experience to deliver specialised care to all ages.

The practice uses a range of evidence-based treatments including Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), and Schema Therapy to meet individual client needs.

They provide a collaborative environment to help clients better understand themselves and learn skills required to improve their quality of life. WorkCover referrals are accepted.

Telehealth sessions are available, making the practice accessible to clients across the Hunter Region and NSW.
